name: Canva
summary:
Canva is the design editor at canva.com. Its icon is often hosted on static.canva.com even when the page is canva.com. The source column shows the final image URL.

Checked 12 November 2026 against canva.com. HTML came from https://www.canva.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://static.canva.com/static/images/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4414 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 32×32.
